title: Laddu, Chintu and the Too-Small Hole
moral: Being brave means trying, even when you feel a little scared.
description: It's cricket time in Masti Nagar, until the little red ball rolls into a teeny-tiny hole in the old banyan tree! Big Laddu can't fit, Chintu's broom plan goes BONK, and Golu just eats a leaf. Learn BIG and small with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu in this funny animated story about courage for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: The End! Remember, friends: being brave means trying, even when you feel a little scared. Uh-oh... Golu is nibbling the The End sign! Ba-a-a-a! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: Hi hi! Guess what? It was a sunny morning in Masti Nagar, and it was cricket time in the lane!
Laddu is BIG and round, like a happy laddoo. Chintu is small and skinny, like a noodle with glasses!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Bowl it, Chintu! I will hit it all the way to the jalebi shop!
WHACK! The little red ball zoomed away... boing, boing, BONK! Right off Golu's bottom!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

popups.sub: Laddu is big, Chintu is small

narration.text: The ball rolled and rolled... right into a little hole in the old banyan tree! Plop!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: No problem! My big hand will grab it!
Squeeeeze! Squiiish! Laddu's big hand would not go in. He tried his head... STUCK! Then POP! Out he wobbled!
Is the hole big or small? What do you think?
Small! A teeny-tiny small hole! You're so clever!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! A BIG broom will push the ball out! It's a plan... a slightly wobbly plan!
But the big broom was too big for the small hole. Swish, swish... BONK! It bopped Laddu on the nose!
Then Pinky zoomed in and did her super-loud whistle. FWEEEEET! Come out, ball!
The ball did not come out. But three mangoes fell down! Bonk, bonk, bonk!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Mangoes! Arre wah... is it lunch time already?

narration.text: Next, Golu the goat trotted up and poked his nose into the hole. Sniff, sniff...

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Out he came, munching a leaf! Crunch, crunch. No ball. Silly Golu!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Chintu! Your arm is thin and small. It will fit! Leave it to Pinky... I mean, to you!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: M-m-me? But it's so dark in there!
And then, from deep inside the tree, came a sound... GRRRRUMBLE!

narration.text: Just then, Dadaji came by with his big walking stick. Tap, tap, tap.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Dadaji, I'm scared. What if something growly is in there?

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Being brave means feeling a little scared, and trying anyway. Your friends are right beside you, and... and... zzzz.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes!
Look at Dadaji and Golu. Who is BIG, and who is small?
Dadaji is big and tall! Golu is small! Wah, you got it!

popups.sub: Dadaji is big, Golu is small

narration.text: Chintu took a big breath. Laddu and Pinky cheered. Slowly, slowly, he put his small arm into the hole.
Can you cheer for Chintu too? Say it loud... You can do it, Chintu!
Then... GRRRRUMBLE! Again! Everybody jumped!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Hee hee... sorry! That was my tummy. It wants jalebis!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: I got it! The ball! And... Laddu's old lunch box?

narration.text: That evening, the game started again. This time, small Chintu had the BIG bat!
WHACK! The ball flew high, high, HIGH! Laddu ran to catch it, tripped on his own feet, and rolled like a ball! Roly-poly, roly-poly!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: I was scared, but I tried! Now I feel BIG inside!
And Golu? He quietly ate the score card. Of course!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.text: Let's remember! Was the hole in the banyan tree big, or small?
Small! Yes! Only a small arm could fit!
And who is bigger... Laddu, or Golu?
Laddu! Laddu is big, and Golu is small. Super smart!

narration.text: That night, there were jalebis for everyone! A big one for Laddu, and a small one for Chintu.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Thank you, friends. You helped me be brave!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah, jalebi time! Chintu, next time, find my lunch box... with lunch inside!
And Golu? He tried to eat a paper lantern! Ba-a-a-a!
